description: This file implements thread-local storage management and thread registration functions for Windows in the starboard platform, including setting and getting thread-local values, and registering the main thread.

classes.name: SbThreadPrivate
classes.description: Represents thread-specific private data, including thread handle and join status.

methods.name: ThreadSetLocalValue
methods.description: Sets a thread-local value for a given key.

methods.name: ThreadGetLocalValue
methods.description: Retrieves a thread-local value for a given key.

methods.name: RegisterMainThread
methods.description: Registers the current thread as the main thread, duplicating its handle and setting thread-local storage.

methods.name: GetCurrentSbThreadPrivate
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-private data for the current thread, registering the main thread if necessary.
